schema_notes: The 'source_date' field uses ISO 8601 calendar dates for verified-day manuals, or the literal string 'unresolved' when a within-month revision date has not been independently verified.

The 'verification_status' field uses one of: 'source_file_compared', 'source_file_received_pdf_text_sampled', 'source_file_hash_match_only', 'user_attached_pdf_not_accessible_in_environment', 'source_file_received_distribution_mode_blocks_text_extraction', 'pending', or 'unknown'.
Do not advance 'source_date' to a specific day without either (a) byte-level identity with a dated source file or (b) explicit page-level evidence of a dated revision marker inside the manual.

The optional 'alternate_source_files' array on each 'current' entry holds non-primary source artifacts (e.g., HWP, HWPX, archived PDF exports) with their own per-file 'source_date', 'source_date_evidence', 'file_sha256', 'extraction_primary_format', and 'verification_status'. Filename-level evidence on an alternate source file does not by itself promote the primary entry's 'source_date'.

The 'source_date' and the 'pdf_internal_creation_date' fields encode different facts. 'source_date' is the source-file revision date as identified by filename, source-file manifest, or page-level evidence (e.g., '2026-05-21'). 'pdf_internal_creation_date' is the export timestamp recorded inside the PDF /Info dictionary by the PDF generator (e.g., macOS Quartz PDFContext writes the time at which the PDF was rendered from the HWP). They commonly differ when the source manual is authored in HWP and exported to PDF some days after the source revision; the manifest must record both honestly without conflating them.

The 'extraction_primary_format' field declares the format actually used for downstream text extraction (TOC, crosswalk, audit). The 'source_file_format_available' array lists every format committed under the canonical source-manual directory. For the 2026.5 manuals, 'pdf' is the primary extraction format; the matching HWP companion files are distribution-mode and their body text cannot be extracted by available tooling.
The 2026-06-26 PDF refresh uses readable desktop PDF exports as the primary extraction format; HWP/HWPX distribution-mode diagnostics are not used as readable production text.
